title: problem with versions open5gs+ueransim
body:
Hi, 
Thanks in advance. I was using open5gs v2.2.3 with UERANSIM v.3.2.2 and everything was fine. This monday, i updated the version of open5gs to v2.3.3 and, surprisingly, all started to fail. The error is when i deploy the UE, causing the reboot of the SMF. I thought that the error could be the version of UERANSIM, but i updated to 3.2.4 and it fails too.
